name: Takeway ABS Portable Solar Inverter ESS Series (600W / 1200W)
description: Flame-retardant ABS body portable energy storage system (ESS) series available in 600W and 1200W pure sine wave power ratings. Models include ABS-600W-576WH (576Wh LiFePO4 battery, 1x AC 220V sine wave socket) and ABS-1200W-1152WH (1152Wh LiFePO4 battery, 3x AC 220V sine wave sockets). Equipped with 15W top wireless charging pad, 5W LED work light with 2-step dimming/flash, dual USB-A, dual Type-C, DC cigarette lighter 12V 10A, XT60 high-current fast charging, and dual 18V solar panel inputs.

name: Takeway Metal Body Portable Solar Inverter ESS Series (200W / 300W / 600W)
description: Heavy-duty metal casing portable energy storage system series available in three high-performance power ratings: MB-200W-192WH (200W Pure Sine, 192Wh LiFePO4), MB-300W-384WH (300W Pure Sine, 384Wh LiFePO4), and MB-600W-640WH (600W Pure Sine, 640Wh LiFePO4). Engineered for rugged industrial, commercial, and outdoor off-grid power needs. Features AC 220V 50Hz pure sine wave output (up to 2 sockets), 12V 10A DC cigarette lighter socket, dual USB-A ports, dual Type-C ports (on 600W), and a built-in 5W emergency LED light with 2-step dimming and flashing. Supports fast charging via 18V solar panels (up to 2 pcs max), car lighter adapter, and AC grid power.

name: Takeway Monocrystalline Solar PV Modules (40W - 165W)
description: High-efficiency Class-A monocrystalline PV modules available in PV1240 (40W), PV1250 (50W), PV1275 (75W), and PV12165 (165W). Featuring IP65 junction box with dual bypass diodes.

name: Takeway Portable Solar Mobile Fast Charger 15W Mono
description: Model SMC-15W. Ultra-portable 9V 15W Monocrystalline solar folding charger with 3x USB-A ports, 1x USB-C PD port, multi-device charging cable, and IP65 rugged casing.

name: Takeway Solar Rechargeable Pedestal Mist/Fan
description: Model SOLAR-FAN-FS578-WH. 16-inch height-adjustable pedestal fan powered by 9V 12W solar panel and 7.4V 5.2Ah lithium battery. 3-speed remote control and integrated LED night light.

name: Takeway 4G HD PTZ Solar CCTV Security Camera Series (Single & Dual Lens / 7W Solar)
description: 4G cellular solar-powered security surveillance camera family featuring both Single-Lens (Model SOLAR-XG06-4G, 5MP FHD IR) and Dual-Lens (Model SOLAR-XG06-4G-DUAL, 5MP+5MP FHD IR) systems. Integrated 5V 7W monocrystalline solar panel paired with high-capacity 3.7V 8000mAh lithium-ion battery delivering 5-7 days of continuous backup even during overcast weather. Includes full 360° pan-tilt rotation, human detection auto-tracking & recording, crystal-clear infrared night vision, 2-way audio intercom, up to 256GB SD card storage, and remote live-monitoring via the V380 Pro mobile app. IP66 weatherproof rating.

name: Takeway Solar CCTV Security Camera Series (3 Real & 5 Real Zoom / 4G & WiFi)
description: Professional solar surveillance camera series available in 5 Real Optical Zoom (Model SOLAR CCTV-T845REAL) and 3 Real (Model SOLAR CCTV-T643REAL), with both 4G cellular and high-speed WiFi connectivity options. Features 5MP FHD imaging, 5V 7W solar panel, 3.7V 8000mAh lithium battery with 5-7 days continuous backup, full 360° pan-tilt view, infrared night vision, human motion detection recording, 2-way audio intercom, and up to 256GB TF card support via V380 Pro app. IP66 weatherproof housing.

name: Takeway Solar CCTV Flood Light with PTZ Zoom Camera 30W
description: Model SOLAR-FL-CCTV-30. Commercial solar floodlight with 58 Pcs 5054 LED, 3.2V 25Ah LiFePO4 battery, and built-in FHD 5MP 4G/WiFi camera with 360° rotation and 7-day cloud/SD backup.

name: Takeway 90W Solar CCTV Street Light (4G Fixed Lens)
description: Model SOLAR-SL-CCTV-15-1LENS-4G NO PTZ. Street light luminaire featuring 201 LEDs, 5V 16W panel, 3.2V 12Ah battery, motion radar sensor, and 5MP FHD 4G integrated surveillance camera.

name: Takeway Solar CCTV Street Light 90W (4G Live Stream PTZ)
description: Model SOLAR-SL-CCTV-20-1LENS. Combined 90W street luminaire and 4G HD PTZ security camera with 3.2V 20Ah LiFePO4 battery, radar motion brightness modulation, and V380 Pro mobile control.

name: Takeway Panoramic Triple-CCTV 4G Solar Street Luminaire
description: Model SOLAR-SL-CCTV-20-4LENS. 360° total-perimeter multi-angle surveillance featuring 3+1 lenses (15MP total), 180 Pcs high-efficiency LEDs, 3.2V 20Ah battery, and remote smartphone monitoring.

name: Takeway Metal Body All-in-One Solar Street Light 80W
description: Model TAKEWAY-METAL80. Heavy-duty die-cast aluminum street luminaire with 180 LED 5054, 5V 85W Mono panel, 3.2V 80Ah LiFePO4 battery, adjustable mounting angle bracket, and multi-mode remote.

name: Takeway Heavy-Duty Metal All-in-One Solar Street Light (80W / 100W / 120W)
description: Models SL-INT-METAL80 (80W), SL-INT-METAL100 (100W), and SL-INT-METAL120 (120W). Die-cast architectural aluminum body with 5V Mono panel, 3.2V LiFePO4 battery (80Ah-120Ah), 300 Pcs 5054 LEDs, adjustable mounting bracket, and 18-24 hour backup.

name: Takeway High-Power Optical Lens Solar Street Light HP Series (60W / 80W)
description: Models TAKEWAY-HP60 (60W) and TAKEWAY-HP80 (80W). 8-Lens optical batwing distribution luminaire with up to 432 Pcs 1W LEDs, 5V 85W Monocrystalline panel, 3.2V 80Ah LiFePO4 battery pack, and dusk-to-dawn intelligent controller.

name: Takeway Semi-Integrated Solar Street Light Series (12W - 50W)
description: Complete commercial and municipal roadway luminaire series spanning 12W, 15W, 18W, 20W, 24W, 30W, and 50W. Models include standard wide-beam fixtures (TAKEWAY-SEMI-12R/20R/30R/50R with up to 766 Pcs high-efficiency LEDs) and the dedicated optical batwing lens fixture (TAKEWAY-SEMI-30R-LENS with 60 Pcs 5054 optical lenses). Paired with heavy-duty external monocrystalline solar panels (10V 40W up to 18V 100W) and internal LiFePO4 battery banks (6.4V 18Ah up to 12.8V 36Ah) for 12-16 hours all-night lighting and multi-day rainy day backup.

name: Takeway Apple Series All-in-One Solar Street Light (40W / 50W)
description: Models SLSOLARINT-APPLE40 (40W) and SLSOLARINT-APPLE50 (50W). Sleek Apple curved aerodynamic body with 576/864 LEDs, 5V Mono panel, 3.2V LiFePO4 battery (42Ah/56Ah), and radar sensor (100% / 15% brightness).

name: Takeway KING Series All-in-One Solar Street Light (35W / 45W)
description: Models SLSOLARINT-KING35 (35W) and SLSOLARINT-KING45 (45W). Commercial-grade street luminaires with up to 732 Pcs 0.5W LEDs, 5V Mono panel, 3.2V 30Ah LiFePO4 battery, and built-in radar motion sensor with 2-night reserve.

name: Takeway AERO PLUS Aerodynamic Solar Street Light Series (25W - 35W)
description: Models SL-AEROPLUS-25 (25W), SL-AEROPLUS-30 (30W), and SL-AEROPLUS-35 (35W). Aerodynamic low-drag wind-resistant luminaires with up to 1152 Pcs 5730 LEDs, 5V 34W Mono panel, 3.2V 30Ah LiFePO4 battery, and 2-night intelligent energy management.

name: Takeway AERO Series All-in-One Solar Street Light Series (25W - 35W)
description: Models SL-AERO-INT-25 (25W), SL-AERO-INT-30 (30W), and SL-AERO-INT-35 (35W). Slimline AERO design street fixtures with 480-800 LED 5730 Epistar, 5V Mono panel (23W-34W), 3.2V LiFePo4 battery (20Ah-30Ah), 45mm pole mount, and 2-night emergency reserve.

name: Takeway Optical Lens Solar Street Light Series (25W / 35W)
description: Models SLSOLARINT-2LENS-25R (25W, 2-Lens) and SLSOLARINT-3LENS-35R (35W, 3-Lens). Optical lens street luminaires with 108/162 Pcs 2W LEDs, 5V Mono panel (26W/36W), 3.2V LiFePO4 battery (20Ah/30Ah), and radar motion brightness modulation.

name: Takeway SPACE Series 12-Lens Solar Street Luminaire (25W / 35W)
description: Models SL-INT-SPACE25 (25W) and SL-INT-SPACE35 (35W). Futuristic aesthetic with 12 precision optical cluster lenses, 72 Pcs 5054 LEDs, 5V 30W Mono panel, 3.2V 30Ah LiFePO4 battery, and 5-7M mounting height.

name: Takeway Tilt-Adjustable Panel Solar Street Light (10W / 15W)
description: Models SL-INT-ADJ-10 (10W) and SL-INT-ADJ-15 (15W). Features tilt-adjustable monocrystalline solar panel for optimal seasonal sun alignment. High efficiency LEDs (180-200 Lm/W), 3.2V LiFePO4, wall/pole mount.

name: Takeway STAR Series Solar Street Light Series (5W - 15W)
description: Models SLSOLARINT05R-STAR (5W, 1-Window), 10R-STAR (10W, 2-Window), and 15R-STAR (15W, 3-Window). Optical array luminaires with up to 576 LED 2835 Epistar, 5V Mono panel, 3.2V LiFePo4 battery, 50mm pole mount, and multi-function IR remote.

name: Takeway Double Body Solar Street Light Series (5W - 25W)
description: Models SLSOLARINT05R (5W, 1W), 10R (10W, 2W), 15R (15W, 3W), 20R (20W, 4W), and 25R (25W, 6W). 1 to 6 Window high-efficiency luminaires with up to 480 LED 5730 Epistar, 5V Mono panel, 3.2V LiFePo4 battery up to 25Ah, and optical motion sensor.

name: Takeway Single Body Solar Street Light Series (5W - 20W)
description: Models SLSOLARINT05R-SB (5W, 1W), 10R-SB (10W, 2W), 15R-SB (15W, 3W), and 20R-SB (20W, 4W). Single body all-in-one street lights with up to 320 LED 5730 Epistar, 5V Mono panel, 3.2V LiFePo4 battery, and dawn-to-dusk automated control.

name: Takeway Mini Solar Pathway & Wall Street Light Series (2W - 9W)
description: Models SOLAR-NEW-MINI02 (2W), MINI04 (4W), MINI06 (6W), and SLSOLAR-MINI03 (3W), MINI06 (6W), MINI09 (9W). Compact pathway, boundary wall, and perimeter luminaires with up to 264 LEDs, Mono solar panel, 3.2V lithium battery, and wall mounting bracket included.

name: Takeway Industrial Solar High Bay UFO Light 35W
description: Model SOLAR-HIGHBAY-35R. 290mm circular UFO luminaire with 60 Pcs 5054 LEDs, external 5V 35W Mono panel, 3.2V 30Ah LiFePO4 battery pack, hanging chain mount, and intelligent remote.

name: Takeway LENS Model Commercial Solar Flood Light Series (20W / 30W)
description: Models FLSOLAR-LENS20 (20W) and FLSOLAR-LENS30 (30W). Heavy-duty die-cast flood projectors with up to 400 Pcs 2835 LEDs, optical micro-lenses, 5V Poly panel, 3.2V 25Ah LiFePO4 battery, and timer remote control.

name: Takeway SKY LIGHT Commercial Solar Floodlight Series (20W / 30W)
description: Models FLSOLAR-CITY20 / SKY20 (20W) and FLSOLAR-SKY30 (30W). Premium warehouse & perimeter floodlights with up to 416 Pcs 5730 LEDs, 5V Poly panel, 3.2V 25Ah LiFePO4 battery, 12-16 hour backup, and battery level display.

name: Takeway Foldable Solar Flood Light Series (10W / 15W)
description: Models FLSOLAR-FOLD10 (10W) and FLSOLAR-FOLD15 (15W). Innovative folding solar floodlights with dual white LED arrays (CW+WW), adjustable solar panel angle, Mono panel, lithium battery, and auto on/off sensor.

name: Takeway 360° Solar UFO Garden Post Light 15W RGB+White
description: Model GARDENSOLAR15R-RGB. Circular UFO radial pathway luminaire with 824 Pcs 5730 LEDs, 5V 15W panel, 3.2V 12Ah LiFePO4 battery, 76mm pole mount, and dual Cool White + RGB atmospheric lighting.

name: Takeway Multi-Function Portable Solar Camping Light Series (30W / 50W / 100W)
description: Models EMSOLARFL30 (30W), EMSOLARFL50 (50W), and EMSOLARFL100 (100W). Rugged jobsite & camping luminaires with up to 180 Pcs LEDs, integrated solar panel, LiFePO4 battery, USB power bank function, 360° folding handle, and SOS beacon.

name: Takeway Solar Emergency Camping Lantern Series (with 3-Speed Fan / Reflector)
description: Models EM-4REF-CP100-3IN1, EM-6REF-CP100, and EM-4REF-CP100-3IN1-FAN. All-in-one camping & emergency lanterns with 288 Pcs 5730 LEDs, 5V panel, 3.7V 8000mAh battery, 3-speed cooling fan, USB-C fast charging, and power bank function.

name: Takeway Diamond Architectural Solar Garden Bollard Series (Standard & Mini)
description: Models SOLAR-BOLLARD-BIG-3IN1+RGB (750mm) and MINI (450mm). Architectural diamond prism bollard with 5V Mono panel, 3.7V battery, floor mounting, and multi-color RF remote control.

name: Takeway CUBE & SECRET Vintage Filament Solar Bollards
description: Models SOLAR-BOLLARD-CUBE & SECRET. 860mm/890mm floor-mount landscape bollards featuring tungsten spiral filament LED styling, 5V 3W Mono panel, and dusk-to-dawn automated illumination.

name: Takeway Diamond Pillar & Gate Solar Light Series (Standard & Mini)
description: Models SOLAR-GATE-BIG-3IN1+RGB (185x185mm) and MINI (130x130mm). Square gate and boundary wall pillar lights with crystalline optic, 5V Mono panel, 3.7V battery, and wireless remote control.

name: Takeway Vintage Gate & Pillar Light CUBE & SECRET
description: Model SOLAR-GATE-SECRET-WW / CUBE-WW. Classic lantern-style pillar & boundary gate fixture with warm tungsten spiral filament, 5V 3W panel, 3.7V 2000mAh battery, and IP65 waterproof rating.

name: Takeway Vintage Shadow Lantern Solar Lawn & Wall Light
description: Model SOLAR-LAWN-SHADOW-WW. Designer fluted cone hanging lantern creating dramatic shadow patterns on pathways and garden walls. 5V 2W Mono panel, 3.7V 1500mAh lithium battery.

name: Takeway Expandable Height Multi-Use Solar Lawn Light (2-Way Mount / 5W COB & 90 LED)
description: Model SOLAR-LAWN-2WAY-WW. Modular lawn light with expandable height (275mm to 700mm) with ground spike and floor flange. 5V 2W Mono panel and 3.7V 1800mAh lithium battery.

name: Takeway Solar Flame Torch Lights (Dancing Flame)
description: Model SOLARFLAME. 780mm garden tiki torch with 96 Pcs LEDs simulating realistic flickering dancing fire. 5V 1W panel, 3.7V 1500mAh battery, with flame, breathing, and constant modes.

name: Takeway Modular Solar Wall Washer Light (Expandable)
description: Model SOLAR-WALLWASHER-4LED/UP-WW. 370mm linear wall washer with snap-on connection for seamless infinite interlocking runs. 180° tilt adjustment, 5V 2W panel, and flame/constant modes.

name: Takeway Architectural Facade Solar Wall Light Series (2+2 / 3+3 / 6+6 Beams)
description: Models SOLAR-WL-606 & 6WAY (2+2, 3+3, 6+6 beams). Modern geometric architectural bi-directional sconces casting dramatic light rays across exterior building facades. 5V panel and 3.7V lithium battery.

name: Takeway Solar Garden Spike Lights (Lens & Square)
description: Model SOLAR-SPIKE-LENS-WW & RGB. 18 LED 2835 spot luminaire with adjustable solar head, ground spike or wall bracket, 5V 2W Mono panel, and 3.7V 1200mAh lithium battery.

name: Takeway Solar Spike Mushroom Umbrella & Crystal Landscape Lights
description: Model SOLAR-SPIKE-UMBRELLA-WW. Whimsical mushroom landscape luminaires (6 Pcs set) and crystal square pathway spikes. 5V 2W Mono panel, IP65 waterproof, continuous & breathing light modes.
